data.rationale: The proposal matches the core search flow (Sail To, Sail From, Dates, Search Cruises) with the right parameters and order, and it covers guest count. It misses the final step of clicking the favorite heart on a result, which is the true goal, and it puts the guest step after the search, so it ends in "review the results" instead of favoriting. A browser automation could still be built from its concrete steps and named parameters.
